title: Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision-Language Models via Agentic Model Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.34036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-shot adaptation transfers pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to new domains using a small set of labeled images. Most methods fit prompts, representations, or classifiers within an adaptation procedure specified in advance. Yet the visual distinctions needed for recognition can differ substantially across domains, motivating the question: Can an LLM agent use few-shot examples and model observations to design the adaptation procedure itself? We propose Agentic Model Editing (AME), an agentic framework that jointly designs input transformations, encoder edits, feature computation, and classifier fitting as an executable, domain-customized adaptation program. The agent inspects images, class semantics, model parameters, intermediate representations, and activations to formulate hypotheses about the target task. translated_title: 基于智能体模型编辑的视觉-语言模型小样本适配
translated_abstract: 小样本适配旨在利用少量带标注的图像将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）迁移到新领域。大多数方法在预先指定的适配流程内拟合提示、表征或分类器。然而，识别所需的视觉差异在不同领域之间可能存在很大差异，这引出了一个 问题：LLM 智能体能否利用少量样本示例和模型观察来设计适配流程本身？我们提出了智能体模型编辑（AME），这是一个智能体框架，它将输入变换、编码器编辑、特征计算和分类器拟合联合设计为一个可执行的、领域定制的适配程序。该智能体检查图像、类别语义、模型参数、中间表征和激活值，以形成关于目标任务的假设。它在支持集上实现并测试候选程序，以总体验证准确率指导改进和……
tldr: 该论文提出AME框架，让LLM智能体基于少量样本和对模型的观察，自主设计并迭代优化包含输入变换、编码器编辑和分类器拟合的领域定制适配程序，实现视觉-语言模型的小样本适配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agentic Model Editing (AME), an LLM agent framework that autonomously designs and iteratively refines domain-customized adaptation programs—spanning input transformations, encoder edits, and classifier fitting—to achieve few-shot adaptation of vision-language models.
